The '''Thunderhead portable entertainment system''' was a custom built suite of devices for entertainment industry and built by [[Audio Performance Incorporated]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It included components such as speakers, amplifiers or light emitters.<ref name="Far Horizons" />
